{{Quote|The word around the stronghold is that the local Sulfur Lake Pirates have a pretty nasty beast under their control. I want you to travel to their hideout and take it down.|[[Mako Ghast]]|<ref name="SWG:KtBT" />}}
The '''Bridge Troll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[gurk]] that lived on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The beast was trained by the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]] to guard their [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|hideout]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], enemies of the Sulfur Lake Pirates, raided the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout in order to retrieve the [[memory module]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk|Lok}}</ref> During the assault, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for an underling of Nym's named [[Mako Ghast]] attacked and killed the Bridge Troll.<ref name="SWG:KtBT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bridge Troll appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Bridge Troll was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
